items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 3:1
items.html:
(to the question) Fathers
HB are fathers to ZON, as is known. It is also known that ZON of the ten Sefirot are NHY, and HGT are KHB of the ten Sefirot. Hence HGT are called fathers, since they are the phase of KHB, and likewise in Gadlut they become HBD, and HB are called fathers. And NHY, which are the phase of ZON, are called sons. (Part 1, Page 130, Item 9).
